t: This is Westbourne Grove, a retail road running across Notting Hill. It runs from Kensington Park Road in the west to Queensway in the east, crossing Portobello Road on the way. The western end lies in Kensington and Chelsea, the eastern end in Westminster. You'll find a mix of independent shops and chains, and the street has been called both fashionable and up-and-coming. Admiral Frederick Whitworth Aylmer, the sixth Baron Aylmer, died here. He was a Royal Navy officer who fought in the French Revolutionary and Napoleonic Wars, and rose to the rank of admiral.
